components.name: Primary action
components.description: A filled cobalt action for the current task.
components.css: .ds-primary { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #848b9f); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--panel, #fffaf0); color: var(--ink, #20253b); padding: 9px 13px; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--raised, #e9e4d9); border-color: var(--ink, #20253b); } .ds-primary:disabled { color: #60667b; background: #eae6dc; border-color: #a1a2a7; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2859d4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary { color: white; background: var(--accent, #203fc7); border-color: var(--accent, #203fc7); } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #102994); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #102994); } .ds-primary:disabled { color: #60667b; background: #eae6dc; border-color: #a1a2a7; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: A paper button for a supporting action.
components.css: .ds-secondary { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #848b9f); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--panel, #fffaf0); color: var(--ink, #20253b); padding: 9px 13px; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--raised, #e9e4d9); border-color: var(--ink, #20253b); } .ds-secondary:disabled { color: #60667b; background: #eae6dc; border-color: #a1a2a7; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2859d4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary { font-size: 13px; padding-inline: 10px; }

components.name: Catalog action
components.description: A cobalt-outlined Start or Continue action for a catalog row.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-catalog-action">Start Quality Check <svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h16m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-catalog-action { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #848b9f); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--panel, #fffaf0); color: var(--ink, #20253b); padding: 9px 13px; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-catalog-action:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--raised, #e9e4d9); border-color: var(--ink, #20253b); } .ds-catalog-action:disabled { color: #60667b; background: #eae6dc; border-color: #a1a2a7; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-catalog-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2859d4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-catalog-action { color: var(--accent, #203fc7); border-color: var(--accent, #203fc7); justify-content: space-between; text-align: left; } .ds-catalog-action:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #203fc7); } .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 18px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Part search
components.description: A labeled field that filters parts by name, color or part number.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label">Find a part<input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Name, color or part number"></label>
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, #20253b); font: 600 12px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-search { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #848b9f); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel, #fffaf0); color: var(--ink, #20253b); font: inherit; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #505772); opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2859d4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Catalog wordmark
components.description: The catalog home link with its alignment mark.
components.html: RoboBuild
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font: 750 23px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -1px; color: var(--accent, #203fc7); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mark { box-sizing: border-box; width: 17px; height: 24px; border-top: 3px solid var(--accent, #203fc7); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--accent, #203fc7); position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-mark::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 7px; left: 6px; width: 17px; border-top: 3px solid var(--ink, #20253b); } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2859d4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Part state
components.description: A text label for the inspected part’s assembly state.
components.css: .ds-state { display: inline-block; font: 12px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: #dce4ff; color: var(--teal, #203fa9); border: 1px solid var(--control, #848b9f); border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 9px; }

components.name: Instruction sheet
components.description: The compact step disclosure as it appears when the guide opens.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-sheet { background: var(--panel, #fffaf0); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #c7c1b5); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink, #20253b); } .ds-sheet-toggle { display: flex; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 9px 12px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font: 750 17px/1.2 var(--display, "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif); color: var(--accent, #203fc7); } .ds-sheet-toggle::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-sheet-toggle:hover { background: var(--raised, #e9e4d9); border-radius: 9px; } .ds-sheet[open] .ds-icon { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-sheet-warning { margin-left: auto; font: 650 11px/1.1 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--warning, #793c10); } .ds-sheet-content { padding: 10px 14px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #c7c1b5); font: 15px/1.55 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-sheet-content p { margin: 0; } .ds-sheet-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2859d4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 18px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Step dock
components.description: Persistent guided step controls with a filled watch action.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; background: var(--panel, #fffaf0); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-step { box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #848b9f); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--panel, #fffaf0); color: var(--ink, #20253b); padding: 9px 13px; font: 600 14px/1.35 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-step:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--raised, #e9e4d9); border-color: var(--ink, #20253b); } .ds-step:disabled { color: #60667b; background: #eae6dc; border-color: #a1a2a7; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2859d4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-step { min-width: 0; padding-inline: 10px; } .ds-step.ds-watch { color: white; background: var(--accent, #203fc7); border-color: var(--accent, #203fc7); } .ds-step.ds-watch:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-hover, #102994); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #102994); } .ds-watch { min-width: min(130px, 36vw); } @media (max-width: 599px) { .ds-step { flex: 1; font-size: 12px; padding-inline: 4px; } }

narrative.overview:
Warm paper, cobalt ink, and large serif headings give the guide the feel of a workbook kept beside a physical build. Real CAD renders show the assemblies and parts a builder will encounter.

The guide gives the robot a single blue 3D field. Paper overlays hold the current instruction, camera actions, and step controls so builders can read and handle the model in the same view.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with thin dividing rules.
Cobalt actions and serif headings that mark the reading order.
Real robot geometry and short, labeled controls.
dos: **Do** use the CAD previews and keep the robot in view beside the current step.
**Do** keep step controls reachable by touch and keyboard, including with the instruction sheet expanded.
**Do** keep warning words and original instruction links visible where builders need them.
donts: **Don't** use amber for decorative accents or mark step and part states by color alone.
**Don't** place a separate framed viewer inside the workbench or add an extra canvas for the movement demo.
